title: fix(auth)!: a SAML provider keys its accounts on a stable attribute (Entra object id by default), so the app and the IdP portal reach one account
body:
Fixes #33437

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — widened: the Register SAML Provider form and its bridge (`POST /api/v1/auth/admin/sso/register-saml`) take an optional `mapAccountKey`, the assertion attribute a provider keys its accounts on, stored as the provider's `mapping.extraFields.accountKey`; with none named, a Microsoft Entra ID provider (IdP Entity ID on `sts.windows.net` or `login.microsoftonline.com`) keys on `http://schemas.microsoft.com/identity/claims/objectidentifier` when the assertion carries it, so an IdP-initiated entry after an SP-initiated one (or the other way round) signs in to the same account where it was refused `account_not_linked`. Narrowed: on such a provider a new account's key is that value instead of the NameID, and an account made before this change keeps its NameID key, which a sign-in no longer looks up directly: a sign-in that resolves to the account's email and carries its NameID still signs in to it, but one whose email changed at the IdP no longer reaches it (a new user is made where the provider allows JIT, otherwise the sign-in is refused); and a SAML sign-in whose verified assertion does not carry the account-key value read from the posted one is refused `INVALID_REQUEST`. No first-party composition in this repository registers a SAML provider.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no skill under `skills/**` teaches SAML account keys or the SSO register form; `content/docs/permissions/sso.mdx` gains the rule in this change.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:SAML 账号改用同一提供方的稳定属性做键:管理员可在「注册 SAML 提供方」表单填「Map: Account key attribute」(`mapAccountKey`);不填时,Entra ID 提供方(IdP Entity ID 在 sts.windows.net / login.microsoftonline.com)默认用 `objectidentifier` 声明;其它 IdP 仍用 NameID。
- **为什么改**:同一个人先从应用登录、再从 Entra「我的应用」门户进入(或反过来)时 NameID 不同,#33418 之后第二次进入会被拒(account_not_linked);按你选的 B,现在两种入口进同一个账号,改邮箱也不丢。
- **风险与回滚**:按 21:12Z 补充不迁移旧记录:改动前建的 Entra 账号仍以 NameID 为键,只能经邮箱找到(邮箱在 IdP 改过的人会找不到旧账号)。机制依赖供应商内部的账号查询路径(见 Acceptance notes),升级若改变它,端到端测试会变红。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/sso-saml-account-key.ts`(规则、对供应商的依赖、验证后确认)· `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/objectql-adapter.ts` 中 `samlAccountKeyWhere` / `samlAccountKeyOnCreate` 两处接线 · `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts` 中 `runSsoCallback` 的 SAML 分支。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/sso-saml-refusal-landing.test.ts -t stable`,预期 10 个用例全绿;其中前两例显示 SP 发起与门户发起两次进入后只有一个账号、键为 object id、两次都登录成功。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **A SAML provider keys its accounts on a stable attribute** (`sso-saml-account-key.ts`). The key is, in order: the attribute named at registration (`mapAccountKey`, stored as the provider's `mapping.extraFields.accountKey`); with none named, for an Entra ID provider (its stored issuer's host is `sts.windows.net` or `login.microsoftonline.com`), `http://schemas.microsoft.com/identity/claims/objectidentifier`; otherwise the NameID, as before. When the assertion does not carry the attribute, that sign-in is keyed on its NameID, as before.
  - Same provider only: the account is the pair (provider, key), so a sign-in through another provider never reaches it by the key; an existing account at the same address (password or another provider) is still judged by the linking rule.
  - No migration (maintainer amendment): account rows made before keep their NameID key.
- **Mechanism.** `@better-auth/sso` 1.7.12's SAML mapping has no account-key member (`samlMappingSchema` is strict; the ACS sets `accountId: extract.nameID` after spreading `extraFields`), and there is no seam between verifying the assertion and resolving the account. So:
  1. Before the vendor runs, the ACS request's posted `SAMLResponse` is read once (`samlAssertionPreview`, extending the pre-read #33418 added) for the one assertion's NameID and the key attribute's first value. Only a value written as one plain text is read: a comment, CDATA, an entity reference, child markup, an empty value or a repeated attribute reads nothing, and the NameID keys that sign-in. Both go into the request's SAML scope, with the provider's key attribute read from its stored row.
  2. In that scope the adapter rewrites the vendor's account lookups (`findOne` / `findMany` / `count` on `sys_account` with exactly this provider and this NameID) and account creates to the key value.
  3. The value was read before verification, so it is confirmed at better-auth's `validateUserInfo` gate (run with the vendor's verified attributes before it creates a user, links an account or signs in to one): when the verified assertion does not carry that value, the sign-in is refused `INVALID_REQUEST` (existing plugin-auth ledger code), with a description that names no value and one `warn` line naming the provider and attribute only.
- **Setup form**: `register_saml_provider` gains `mapAccountKey` (`sys-sso-provider.object.ts`), passed by the SAML register bridge in `register-sso-provider.ts`; translations regenerated with `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write --filter=platform-objects`.
- **Docs**: `content/docs/permissions/sso.mdx`, the SAML register table row and a new "Key accounts on a stable attribute" subsection of the SAML mapping section, which now states that both entries reach one account for a provider keyed on a stable attribute (the line #33418 withdrew).
- Changeset: `patch` for `plugin-auth` and `platform-objects`, declared BREAKING with its ADR-0087 disposition.

## Tests

End to end, real `AuthManager` + `better-auth` + `@better-auth/sso` over the in-memory engine, the IdP played with the vendor's own `samlify` signing with a generated key: a new top-level `describe` in `sso-saml-refusal-landing.test.ts` (10 cases):

- Entra: SP-initiated (UPN NameID) then IdP-initiated (persistent opaque NameID): both admitted, one user, one account keyed on the object id, one session owner. Portal first then SP-initiated: the same.
- Entra: an email change at the IdP keeps the account.
- A named attribute keys a provider that is not Entra (both entries, one account); a named attribute is read before the Entra default.
- Same provider only: an account another provider made under the same key is not reached; an existing password account at the same address is refused `account_not_linked`, nothing written.
- Entra assertion without the object id: NameID-keyed. A key value split with an XML comment (signature still valid): not read, NameID-keyed.
- CONTROL: a non-Entra provider with nothing named keys on the NameID whatever the assertion carries; the existing #33418 describe (non-Entra issuer) is unchanged and green, its portal-first case still keyed on the opaque NameID.

Pure halves: `sso-saml-account-key.test.ts` (issuer recognition incl. look-alike hosts, attribute choice, the bridge's mapping write, the preview reading and its refusals, the adapter halves in and out of scope, the confirmation's three branches).

Ablations (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each on committed head `d8d72cf5d1`, run `-t stable` on the landing file; each restore verified blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty; plugin-auth tests import their own `src`, so no rebuild leg):

1. Drop the adapter's create half (`samlAccountKeyOnCreate`): 6 of 10 red (both Entra two-entry cases, email change, both named-attribute cases, same-provider-only); the NameID-keyed cases and the CONTROL stay green.
2. Drop the `findMany` read half (the vendor's `findAccountOwnerByKey`): 4 of 10 red (both two-entry cases, email change, named attribute across entries).
3. Drop the Entra default: 4 of 10 red (both Entra two-entry cases, email change, same-provider-only).

## Acceptance notes

- **Vendor reliance.** The rewrite depends on `@better-auth/sso` 1.7.12 resolving the SAML account through the adapter by `(providerId, accountId = NameID)` within the ACS request. A vendor that changes that lookup leaves the NameID keying the accounts; the end-to-end pins go red on it. The durable fix is upstream: an account-key member in the SAML mapping.
- **The confirmation is defence in depth**: no well-formed IdP response reaches it (the pre-read refuses every shape where its reading and the verifier's can differ), so it is pinned by its pure test, not end to end; unwiring it leaves the end-to-end pins green.
- **No `mapping.id` in the vendor.** The vendor's SAML mapping has no id member to reuse, so the key rides the generic `extraFields` member, as the groups claim does (`extraFields.groups`); `extraFields.accountKey` therefore also appears on the vendor's `userInfo`, which no user column declares.
- **Existing providers**: the attribute is set at registration only; Show/Edit Attribute Mapping neither shows nor changes it (they keep it as stored). Changing it on a provider with accounts would strand them, which is why the form says to set it at registration.
- **Encrypted assertions** carry no readable value before the vendor decrypts them, so such a provider keys on the NameID (documented).
- **Translations**: the new param's label and help text are English in every locale bundle (the generator's fill; `check:i18n-coverage` counts no untranslated label for platform-objects).
